# Dr. Cuterus - Dr. Tanaya Narendra

> Tanaya Narendra, popularly known as Dr. Cuterus, is an Oxford-trained doctor, embryologist, sexual health educator, author, and podcast host based in India. She holds an MBBS from Swami Vivekanand Subharti University and an MSc in Clinical Embryology from the University of Oxford, and is a Fellow of the Royal Society for Public Health (FRSPH).

Dr. Cuterus is known for making sexual and reproductive health education accessible in India, covering topics including periods, PCOD/PCOS, contraception, HPV vaccine awareness, sexual health, and body literacy — most visibly through her Instagram account @dr_cuterus and The Dr. Cuterus Podcast.

She authored the bestselling book "Dr. Cuterus: Everything Nobody Tells You About Your Body" (Penguin, December 2022), translated into Hindi, Punjabi, and Marathi editions.

Recognition includes: Health Influencer of the Year (IHW Council, 2022), Forbes India Top 100 Digital Stars (2023 and 2024), and ELLE Wellness Expert of the Year (2023).

This website (drcuterus.com) is her official site, offering:
- Online sexual and reproductive health consultations, booked via WhatsApp: /appointments
- A blog answering common sexual and reproductive health questions: /blog
- Corporate workshops on sexual health and inclusion: /partnerships
- Information about her book and podcast
